نفوا (form I)

# نُفُّوا (nuffū) /nuf.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of نَفَّ (naffa)
# نِفُّوا (niffū) /nif.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of نَفَّ (naffa)
